title: Juni's Warp Pipes
description: A Warp Pipe mod with tiers that have different ranges
body:
A survival friendly teleportation system based on the warp pipes from the Super Mario series.

Warp Pipes are a Survival friendly option to fast travel as only 2 pipes can be linked at once. Encouraging the player to build a warp zone/room to the many places that they frequent. While still encouraging exploration since linking requires physically going to and from the place you would like to place a warp pipe at.

## Pipes & Ranges

**Green:** 1000 Blocks

**Blue:** 3000 Blocks

**Red:** 5000 Blocks

**Purple:** 7500 Blocks

**Gold:** 10,000 Blocks

**White:** Cross Dimensions within 100 blocks of each pipe
